errors.text: The proposed L1₂ precipitation intervention conflicts with the target mechanism: enhanced L1₂ ordering is associated with maximum embrittlement near 600°C rather than toughness preservation.
The hypothesis does not identify the AlCoCrFeNi2.1 as-cast FCC+B2 eutectic microstructure.
The stated 700–1000°C range misses the critical 550–750°C transition window and the distinct 600°C embrittlement and 750°C recovery conditions.
No duration or meaningful loading-mode boundary is specified; 'several hours' and 'mechanical stress' are not reproducible test conditions.
The cited evidence supports elevated-temperature strength from precipitation, not retention of toughness or the original strength–ductility combination after thermal exposure.
The mechanism omits APBE/modulus changes, restricted cross-slip, planar slip, jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries, stress concentration, and ductile transition-zone formation.
The proposed experiment cannot discriminate precipitation strengthening from the target phase-boundary and ordering mechanisms.
